articles.title: Amy Grant's emotional account of doctors and nurses singing outside Dolly Parton's hospital room
articles.summary: Amy Grant reveals the emotional story of doctors and nurses singing outside Dolly Parton's Vanderbilt Hospital room near the end of her life.
articles.body: Amy Grant shared a touching story from outside Dolly Parton's hospital room. In a new interview with Fox News Digital, the 65-year-old musician opened up about what it meant to her to honor Parton at the 57th Annual GMA Dove Awards, and shared a story she heard from a friend who worked at Vanderbilt Hospital, where Parton died. "Someone in Dolly's close circle had said, 'I know Dolly loves to sing to the tune of 'Amazing Grace,' praise Jesus.' And I said, 'Do you mean praise God? Because that would like be the same syllables,' and she said, 'No praise Jesus and, as a matter of fact, some of the administration, an old and a younger doctor, some of the gathered outside her room toward the end,'" Amy said. "And I'm just trying to imagine, has there ever been a circle of doctors and nurses singing praise Jesus to the tune of 'Amazing Grace' outside anybody's room? I would venture to say no," she added. DOLLY PARTON’S SISTER REVEALS ‘LAST THING’ COUNTRY LEGEND ASKED OF HER BEFORE DEATH Parton died on Tuesday, Aug. 25 at the age of 80, following a brief battle with cancer. While speaking with Fox News Digital, Amy shared many memories from her friendship with Parton, noting the singer "always presented at the top of her game" and was always dressed to the nines. Grant joked that she didn't "know who had the behind the scenes look at Dolly, except maybe God." What Amy called, the "magic" of Parton was her kind spirit and how "she was so intentional with the way she reached out to people." She recalled how kind Parton was when meeting her stage manager, and how she offered to send a video to her guitarist's daughter when she found out her and her friends were having a "Dolly Parton night." "She chose to see other people and my feeling is that's the first act of love. Love sees," Amy said. "Then when I saw Dolly, years later, she said, 'How's that magical child of yours?' All I could think of was like, do you take notes?" Amy said. "When she passed, I did think, man, Dolly, I hope all of us think about the intentional choices that you made for how you wanted to live. And I hope we are all reminded of the power of our own choices for how we might live a little differently." The "Lucky One" singer recently honored Parton with a tribute at the 57th Annual GMA Dove Awards, singing alongside Natalie Grant. She explained she initially was only meant to do the spoken introduction, but Natalie and her husband asked her to join in on the song. The 57th Annual GMA Dove Awards took place on Tuesday, October 6, 2026, at Nashville's Bridgestone Arena, hosted by Tauren Wells. articles.title: Trump staffer Britt McHenry escorted from NBA arena after throwing beer at fan
articles.summary: The Washington Wizards opened their much-anticipated NBA season with a win, but Trump staffer Britt McHenry didn’t see it all. McHenry was in attendance for...
articles.body:
The Washington Wizards opened their much-anticipated NBA season with a win, but Trump staffer Britt McHenry didn't see it all.

McHenry was in attendance for the start of the game between the Wizards and Milwaukee Bucks Wednesday night, but the former Fox News and ESPN host was forced to leave Capital One Arena in Washington, D.C., early after a heated incident with fans.

According to Page Six , McHenry and a friend were sitting in front of a group of fans who became loud and obnoxious. After they allegedly began heckling former Wizard and current Bucks forward Kyle Kuzma, McHenry supposedly asked the fans to "ease up," which prompted them to redirect their attention toward her.

A source told Page Six that one of the fans escalated the situation by saying misogynistic things to McHenry before throwing a drink at the current Trump administration press adviser. McHenry retaliated by doing the same thing. Security later arrived to escort McHenry from the stands, allegedly removing the fan who threw a drink at her as well.

The video shows McHenry had a drink thrown at her while leaving the seat, which led the former Fox News host to grab a beverage and toss it back at the fan, spawning a sort of food fight with several items being sent in her direction. But according to one witness who shared the above video, McHenry also threw a burger at a fan before people began recording the incident.

Page Six claims McHenry was escorted out of the arena. Although the video shows her walking out of the arena with security, TMZ reported McHenry wasn't kicked out, alleging she opted to leave while her friend went back to their seats.

ESPN infamously suspended McHenry for one week after she was caught on video berating a tow company employee. She has since claimed the tow truck company's publicly released video was " highly edited" and "highly doctored. "

McHenry has not yet commented on the videos.

articles.title: ‘Avengers: Doomsday’ Teaser Falls Flat After Promise of a New Look: ‘That’s It??’
articles.summary: Marvel fans were left underwhelmed after the studio dropped a new teaser for “Avengers: Doomsday” during Game 1 of the World Series, offering only a few glim...
articles.body:
Marvel fans were left underwhelmed after the studio dropped a new teaser for "Avengers: Doomsday" during Game 1 of the World Series, offering only a few glimpses of new footage.

In the sneak peek, Pedro Pascal's Mister Fantastic took the mound for a ceremonial first pitch, before the video cut to commentary from a number of MLB players. The teaser also showed glimpses of Chris Evans' return as Steve Rogers, as well as the destruction to come from Robert Downey Jr.'s Doctor Doom. Other notable MCU figures spotted in the clip were Chris Hemsworth's Thor, Letitia Wright's Black Panther, Paul Rudd's Ant-Man and Anthony Mackie's Captain America.

There didn't seem to be any big reveals, despite the fact the MLB teased earlier on Thursday that the first Tampa Bay Rays vs. Milwaukee Brewers World Series game would feature " an exclusive preview of 'Avengers: Doomsday,' " indicating there may be something big to tune in for.

Yet, as fans quickly pointed out, the World Series spot seemed to show more of the same, prompting mixed reactions from fans.

"I had to watch 3 innings of f–king BASEBALL for this s–t," wrote one frustrated fan on X. Another chimed in with, "oh so like 3 new seconds lol." A third commented , "All of that just for like 10 seconds of new footage."

A different fan noted , "sooo 1 new scene … barely," while another bluntly wrote , "THAT'S IT???"

However, not everyone was frustrated by the short sneak peek, as others made sure to voice their excitement for the upcoming superhero movie. "I actually like that they're recycling the same scenes," one fan defended . "I don't want them to give too much away like with 'Spider-Man BND.'"

A different fan expressed a similar sentiment, writing , "I honestly am not mad they didn't show more, I want to enjoy every minute in that theatre."

Watch the new teaser for yourself above.

"Avengers: Doomsday," which arrives in theaters on December 18, was written by Michael Waldron and Stephen McFeely and produced by Kevin Feige and the Russos. It will immediately be followed by a sequel, titled "Avengers: Secret Wars," to be released on December 17, 2027.

articles.title: 'Yet more rest needed': Amitabh Bachchan shares health update after social media break
articles.summary: Veteran actor Amitabh Bachchan shared a fresh update on his health, saying he needs more rest as he continues to recover.
articles.body: Veteran actor Amitabh Bachchan shared a fresh update on his health, saying he needs more rest as he continues to recover. The actor posted the message on his Tumblr blog on Friday, a day after announcing a temporary break from online communication following medical advice.Amitabh Bachchan regularly interacts with fans through his blog and social media accounts. "Yet more rest needed .. adjusting .. thinking and wondering .. the human body and its uniqueness," he wrote.Amitabh Bachchan says he is following doctors' adviceThe actor's latest post follows an earlier message in which he apologised to fans for being unable to share regular updates. Amitabh Bachchan explained that doctors instructed him to avoid writing and communicating online for a few days. He is currently following their advice and prioritising rest.Before his latest Tumblr update, Amitabh Bachchan addressed fans on X while extending his Dussehra greetings. He also explained that his doctors placed him under strict instructions to rest and recuperate."First Dussehra greetings to all .. love happiness, fulfilment, prayers. Under very strict rest and recuperation .. so am not allowed to communicate .. do excuse .. my apologies," he wrote.The actor further asked his followers to treat the message as his response for the time being. He expressed hope that he would be able to communicate more regularly later. "But do take this as my respected response .. more hopefully later."Mumbai police investigate reported bomb threat emailThe health update comes amid reports of a bomb threat email allegedly targeting Amitabh Bachchan's bungalow in Mumbai. According to reports, a school in the city's Bandra-Kurla Complex (BKC) area received the email on Friday.Mumbai Police have launched an investigation into the reported threat. However, it has not been confirmed whether the email specifically named either Jalsa or Prateeksha, the actor's residences in Mumbai. The available information does not establish any connection between the reported threat and Amitabh Bachchan's health update. The police investigation into the email remains ongoing.Amitabh Bachchan's longstanding connection with fansAmitabh Bachchan has used digital platforms for years to share personal reflections and communicate with his audience. He started his personal blog in 2008 and has continued to post updates about his experiences, thoughts and professional activities.Amitabh Bachchan's most recent major film release, according to the information available, was the Tamil-Hindi bilingual action drama 'Vettaiyan'. The film was released in theatres on October 10, 2024. Up next, Big B will be seen in 'Kalki 2'.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: ‘What’s with the hate?’: Kriti Sanon reacts to backlash over her Raksha Bandhan ad outfit on Kareena Kapoor's talk show
articles.summary: Kriti Sanon faced heavy trolling on social media in August over her outfit in a Raksha Bandhan ad, with critics calling it “revealing”.
articles.body: Kriti Sanon faced heavy trolling on social media in August over her outfit in a Raksha Bandhan ad, with critics calling it “revealing”. The brand eventually pulled the ad. Speaking to Kareena Kapoor Khan on 'What Women Want', Kriti has now addressed the backlash. She said she generally doesn’t pay attention to trolls, but added, “But this is something that actually happened recently where my choli became the national debate. I couldn’t believe that my choli had become a six-people panel discussion on prime-time news. I was like, ‘What is going on?’”.Kriti Sanon on her choli becoming a ‘national debate’The actress said she was shocked by the intensity of the hate, but felt the issue went beyond her. “I felt that it was not about me; it was a much larger issue, where I felt like women are under scrutiny for everything, and it is only women who get targeted for the smallest thing,” she said, adding, “The amount of hate that happens. What’s with the hate?” Though she usually ignores trolls, Kriti spoke about how nasty people can get. “People who were talking about culture and respect were ironically the ones who were commenting on my parents’ posts and sister’s posts with the nastiest abusive language. They read all these things. What have they done?”.Kriti Sanon on what women actually want“It is important for women to stand up for themselves because I feel like everything is such a question, and who has given this right to these people to be commenting on us, and for what? What women actually want is to not be judged and for people to actually mind their own business," Kriti concluded.Kriti Sanon’s Raksha Bandhan ad rowThe row began when GIVA released its Raksha Bandhan ad starring Kriti Sanon, in which she wears an Indo-Western outfit and ties a rakhi to her brother and her pet dog. Kriti had earlier responded to the backlash on Instagram, questioning why women are still judged by what they wear. “Also, when will we stop telling women what to wear? Ethnic fashion has evolved over the years, yet a woman’s respect for her culture is still measured by her clothes. articles.title: Tiger Shroff sells Mumbai apartment for Rs 9 crore days after firing incident near his car in Juhu, third property sale by the actor in about a year
articles.summary: Tiger Shroff has sold an apartment in Mumbai’s Khar West for Rs 9 crore.
articles.body: Tiger Shroff has sold an apartment in Mumbai’s Khar West for Rs 9 crore. As per property registration documents, the deal was registered on October 22, 2026. This is the third property sale by the actor in about a year. Let's learn more about it in detail.Details of the Khar West apartmentAccording to documents shared by real estate data analytics firm CRE Matrix, the flat is on the ninth floor of Rustomjee Paramount D Co-operative Housing Society. It has a carpet area of 1,291.14 sq ft and an exclusive area of 95.80 sq ft. The sale was done at around Rs 64,891 per sq ft. A stamp duty of Rs 54 lakh was paid, and the deal includes two covered car parking spaces.The documents show that Tiger had bought the flat from developer Keystone Realtors Private Limited on July 17, 2018, for Rs 7.61 crore. He took possession on November 30, 2019. The actor could not be reached for comment.The sale comes soon after Tiger made headlines for a scary incident. On the evening of October 18, at least two men opened fire at his car in Mumbai’s Juhu area and then fled on a motorcycle. Tiger escaped relatively unhurt, but his driver and a bystander were injured.Earlier sale in the same projectAbout a year ago, Tiger Shroff sold another flat in the same project for Rs 15.6 crore, as per documents reviewed by Square Yards. He made a gain of nearly 31% on the deal.That apartment was on the 22nd floor and had a carpet area of 1,989.72 sq ft and a built-up area of 2,189 sq ft. He had bought it in 2018 for Rs 11.62 crore. It came with three car parking spaces. The buyer paid a stamp duty of Rs 93.60 lakh and registration charges of Rs 30,000.Rustomjee Paramount is spread over 1.65 acres and offers two, three, four and five-bedroom apartments, according to Square Yards.Pune property sold earlier this yearEarlier in 2026, the actor also sold a residential property in Pune’s Hadapsar for Rs 8.87 crore, according to property registration documents accessed by Zapkey. He had bought it in March 2024 for Rs 7.5 crore, which gives a gross return on investment of 18.3%, Zapkey said.The apartment is in the Yoo Pune building by Panchshil Realty and was sold along with three parking spaces. It measures 4,249 sq ft and was sold at Rs 20,891 per sq ft. The deal was registered on March 31, 2026, with a stamp duty of over Rs 62 lakh and a registration fee of Rs 30,000.Tiger Shroff is known for his action roles and dancing skills. The son of veteran actor Jackie Shroff, he made his acting debut in 2014 with ‘Heropanti’.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.body: Hollywood star Jason Momoa has officially put down permanent roots in New Zealand’s South Island. According to recent reports, the beloved actor officially acquired Sam Neill’s former Queensland property located in New Zealand following his death. The ownership of the estate had been earlier transferred to his ex-wife, Noriko Watanabe, and now, Momoa has bought out the grand estate. Here’s a look into the iconic home.Jason Momoa buys out Sam Neill’s former New Zealand estateAccording to reports from Realtor.com, the beloved actor bought the ‘Jurassic Park’ actor’s property earlier this year in September. He spent a whopping NZD 15 million on the property, which is overall NZD 3.5 million above the official rating valuation. The estate is situated in the rural enclave of Dalefield, near Queenstown in New Zealand's Central Otago region, a famous area that is known for mountain landscapes and large residential holdings.OneRoof also reported that this transaction marks the second-highest residential sale in the Queenstown-Lakes district in 2026, trailing only behind a luxury lodge on Mooney Road in Speargrass Flat that had earlier sold for NZD 16.5 million.More about Sam Neill’s former Queensland propertySir Sam Neill bought the space in 1999 and owned the property until it was transferred into his ex-wife’s name. The main residential structures on the property were designed by New Zealand architect Richard Naish. Other than that, the main central living house alongside a dedicated "Clubhouse" has been built for hosting and social gatherings there. Remnants of those experimental plantings still remain on the property. articles.title: Quentin Tarantino Surprises Fans With 17 Minutes of ‘The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth’ at AFI Fest
articles.summary: Quentin Tarantino surprised audiences on Friday night at AFI Fest when he shared the first 17 minutes of “The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth.” Taranti...
articles.body:
Quentin Tarantino surprised audiences on Friday night at AFI Fest when he shared the first 17 minutes of "The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth."

Tarantino made a special appearance at the TCL Chinese Theatre in Hollywood, following a screening of "Once Upon a Time … In Hollywood." Following the Q&A moderated by Rotten Tomatoes' Jacqueline Coley, the filmmaker said, "Well, I could talk a little bit about 'The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth,' or I could show you the first 17 minutes."

Directed by David Fincher , who was also in attendance, the film sees the return of Cliff Booth played by Brad Pitt. The film picks up in 1977 from the original film's 1969 timeline. The logline reads: "Los Angeles no longer needs a hippie-slaying stuntman the way it did. But Hollywood will always have problems, problems that can only be solved by someone with Cliff's unique (occasionally extralegal) abilities. When he's not earning his keep bartending or as a projectionist, Cliff Booth is a fixer — solving situations for Hollywood's great and, sometimes, not so good."

During the Q&A, Tarantino, who wrote the screenplay, shared his decision to revisit Cliff Booth. He said, "I tend to not remember good reviews of mine in quotes; I remember the bad reviews in quotes, but I don't really remember good reviews of mine in quotes. But one quote that I do remember somebody writing about 'Once Upon a Time in Hollywood' was, 'This seems like the first world Quentin Tarantino has ever created that he would like to live in,' and there is that aspect; I loved the Cliff Booth character," Tarantino said. "I loved the way that Brad played him, and there was this aspect of him as sort of like a paperback hero. I could see like a series of paperbacks with Cliff Booth getting involved with this adventure or that adventure or something like that."

The Netflix film is set to premiere in Imax theaters on Nov. 25, before hitting the streamer Dec. 23.

He also talked about his upcoming play "The Popinjay Cavalier ," which stars Sacha Baron Cohen and is set to premiere in London's West End next year. "I'm not going to talk a whole lot about that, but our previews are in February. In November we'll start rehearsals." He went on to say, "I'm just a writer, and that's just kind of what I do. I'm always writing."

articles.title: Quote of the day by Jennifer Aniston: ‘I'm still a romantic. I still believe in love,’ a reminder to never lose faith in love
articles.summary: Jennifer Aniston shares her heartfelt belief in love despite heartbreak, encouraging others to embrace love and healing after relationships. Discover insights on love and moving forward.
articles.body: There's a strange thing about heartbreak. You can spend weeks telling yourself that you're fine, get on with your work, meet your friends and barely think about the person. Then a song comes on, or you walk past a place you used to visit together, and suddenly you're remembering things you thought you'd moved past. Healing doesn't always happen in a straight line, no matter how much you'd like it to.For some people, the hardest part isn't getting over a relationship. It's finding the courage to let someone new into their lives afterwards. The thought of starting again can be exciting, but it can also be frightening when you know how badly things can hurt.Today's quote of the day by Jennifer Aniston is: “I'm still a romantic. I still believe in love.”What does Jennifer Aniston's quote mean?Aniston said this in an interview with Harper's Bazaar Australia. When she was asked if her past relationships had changed the way she felt about love, her answer was clear: she still believed in it.It's easy to say you believe in love when things are going well. But when you break up, you start thinking about what went wrong. Trusting someone new seems like a task, as you are afraid of going through the same pain and betrayal. The ghosts of the past haunt your present and lurk over the future.Sometimes, you become more cautious without even realising it. A new person might seem lovely, but you're already wondering when things will go wrong. You might avoid getting attached because, in your mind, not caring too much means you can't get hurt too badly.The trouble is that protecting yourself from every possible disappointment can also keep you from getting close to anyone. That doesn't mean you should ignore your instincts or trust people before they've earned it. It simply means that one person's actions don't have to become the standard by which you judge everyone else.Why does Jennifer Aniston's message still matter today?People are often quick to tell someone who is heartbroken to move on. They might say there are plenty of other people out there or that the breakup happened for a reason. Sometimes those words help. Other times, you just want someone to understand that you're not ready to stop missing the person yet.There's no fixed schedule for getting over someone. You might feel better after a few weeks, or you might need considerably longer. You can know that ending the relationship was the right decision and still feel sad about it. Those two things aren't mutually exclusive.Then comes the question of dating again. Friends might encourage you to put yourself out there, but only you know when you're ready. There's nothing wrong with enjoying your own company for a while, rediscovering old interests or getting comfortable with life as it is now.Being single doesn't have to be a waiting period before your next relationship. It can just be a part of your life in its own right.At the same time, it's worth remembering that a new relationship won't necessarily repeat the old one. The person will be different, the circumstances will be different, and you'll probably be a little different yourself. You may have a clearer idea of what you need from a partner, which behaviours you're no longer willing to accept and where you need to communicate better.That doesn't mean you should enter a relationship expecting everything to work out. Real relationships are rarely that tidy. People have disagreements, misunderstand each other and occasionally say the wrong thing.Jennifer Aniston's early lifeJennifer Aniston was born on 11 February 1969 in Sherman Oaks, California. Acting was familiar to her from an early age, as her father, John Aniston, also worked in the industry. He became widely known for playing Victor Kiriakis in the television soap opera 'Days of Our Lives'.Aniston attended Fiorello H. LaGuardia High School of Music & Art and Performing Arts in New York City, where she studied acting. But having an interest in the profession and a parent who understood the industry didn't mean her own career would automatically take off.She spent her early years taking smaller roles and looking for opportunities. The success most people associate with her name was still ahead of her.How did Jennifer Aniston rise to fame?In 1994, Jennifer Aniston landed one of the most iconic roles of her career. She played Rachel Green in 'Friends,' the sitcom which became a major success, and her character soon became one of television's most recognisable personalities. Viewers followed her friendships, romances and career struggles, while her hairstyle became a trend of its own.The role changed Aniston's career, but she didn't stop working in television and film once the sitcom ended in 2004. She appeared in movies such as 'Bruce Almighty', 'The Break-Up' and 'Marley & Me'. Later, she returned to television with 'The Morning Show'. It also starred Reese Witherspoon.Her personal life has also attracted plenty of public attention, particularly her relationships. Celebrities may have millions of people following their lives, but when a relationship ends, they go through many of the same feelings as everyone else.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.summary: Discover the fascinating history and architectural beauty of the former Dinah Shore Estate, now owned by Leonardo DiCaprio, available for luxury rental in Palm Springs.
articles.body: Long before Leonardo DiCaprio became associated with this Palm Springs property, it belonged to singer and television personality Dinah Shore. Designed during the 1960s, the residence later drew attention when it was advertised as a luxury holiday rental for $4,500 per night. Its story connects an era of American entertainment with a distinctive chapter in California's architectural history.The former Dinah Shore Estate stands at 432 West Hermosa Place in Palm Springs. According to Greater Palm Springs, the residence was designed by architect Donald Wexler in 1964. Its mid-century modern design features steel-beam construction, expansive glass windows and views of the San Jacinto Mountains.A residence designed for Dinah ShoreWexler designed the home for Shore, whose career spanned singing, television and entertainment. The architect became known for modernist buildings that responded to Southern California's climate and landscape.The estate reflects that philosophy through broad glass surfaces, open interiors and clean architectural lines. These features let in plenty of natural light and make the desert views feel like part of the living spaces.It’s significant for its architecture too, not just because a celebrity lived there. The residence is part of Palm Springs' mid-century modern tradition, in which designers explored ways to connect indoor living with outdoor surroundings.How did the property enter the luxury rental market?DiCaprio purchased the estate in 2014 for a reported $5.23 million. By 2015, it was being advertised as a holiday rental for $4,500 per night, with a minimum two-night stay. The rate was reported again in 2016.The main residence covers approximately 7,000 square feet and includes six bedrooms and seven-and-a-half bathrooms. Features reported during its rental period included a sunken living room, fireplace, cocktail bar and formal dining area. The grounds also included a swimming pool, tennis court and guesthouse.The design details behind its appealThe home’s architecture prioritises space, light and views rather than elaborate ornamentation. Large windows connect the main rooms with the gardens, while the pool and recreational facilities extend the living environment outdoors.The sunken living room gives the interior a distinctive period character. Together with the bar and entertainment areas, it reflects a design approach suited to hosting guests while preserving separate spaces for relaxation.These characteristics help explain the continuing interest in mid-century modern houses across Palm Springs. Their appeal comes from the way architecture, climate and landscape work together rather than from celebrity ownership alone.A Hollywood connection across generationsShore’s ownership gave the estate its original entertainment-industry connection. DiCaprio’s later purchase brought the house renewed attention among celebrity-home watchers and luxury property enthusiasts.The residence also sits in Old Las Palmas, a Palm Springs neighbourhood associated with distinctive homes and prominent residents. Its location adds context to the property's story, although it should not be taken as evidence that every celebrity associated with the area visited this particular house.The $4,500 nightly listing brought the estate into the spotlight, but its history is more substantial than a rental price. articles.title: F1 United States GP: Lewis Hamilton pips Max Verstappen in FP3
articles.summary: Ferrari heads into qualifying having topped every practice session at COTA
articles.body:
Lewis Hamilton finished final practice on top at Formula 1's United States Grand Prix, leading Max Verstappen and Charles Leclerc into qualifying at Austin.

Hamilton was the only driver to break the 1m35s barrier in the final 20 minutes of third practice, as frequent track limits transgressions kept Ferrari team-mate Leclerc from leapfrogging him on the leaderboard.

Following an opening quarter of the session which can only be described as pedestrian, action picked up as Hamilton set a 1m36.716s on softs to get ahead of a number of medium-tyred install laps.

His time was soon beaten by Liam Lawson in the Racing Bulls and McLaren's Oscar Piastri , while several heavy hitters kept turning laps on medium tyres instead.

Verstappen even went top courtesy of a 1m35.702s on the yellow sidewall tyre, despite recurring complaints about his unsettling downshifts.

Hamilton swiftly improved upon the Dutchman's lap, using softs to set a 1m35.561s. But when Leclerc took over command with a 1m35.127s despite using the slower mediums, that underlined there was still a lot more pace to find.

Entering the final 20 minutes, Antonelli took a tenth out of Leclerc's time on softs, but his lap was scratched for breaking track limits at Turn 9.

Verstappen did adhere to the white lines to set a 1m35.061s and go top, with Red Bull the quickest car through sector one, only for Hamilton to dip below the 1m35s barrier with a 1m34.893s.

Track limits, which have been a recurring theme throughout practice, also kept Leclerc from reclaiming first as he dipped over the white line at Turn 10.

That meant the Monegasque had to settle for third behind Hamilton and Verstappen, setting up a finely poised qualifying session on Saturday afternoon.

Championship leader Antonelli was fourth ahead of Mercedes team-mate George Russell , as the Silver Arrows appears to be a half-step behind on pure pace, with Piastri sixth in the difficult to tame MCL40.

In the Audi , Nico Hulkenberg kept McLaren 's Lando Norris from seventh, with the world champion's 1m35.2s also deleted for track limits at Turn 10.

Alpine driver Pierre Gasly was ninth, a full second behind Hamilton, with Isack Hadjar 10th in the second Red Bull as the Frenchman was left frustrated by his car's handling.

articles.title: Gasperini: ‘Roma felt we could win, 3-3 at Napoli a positive confidence booster’
articles.summary: Gian Piero Gasperini insists Roma ‘felt we could win’ the game with Napoli even after going 3-2 down, and is ultimately satisfied with a 3-3 draw. ‘It’s anot...
articles.body:
Gian Piero Gasperini insists Roma 'felt we could win' the game with Napoli even after going 3-2 down, and is ultimately satisfied with a 3-3 draw . 'It's another positive confidence booster.'

The Giallorossi showed they refused to give up after going 2-0 down at the Stadio Diego Armando Maradona to an acrobatic Andre Frank Zambo Anguissa bicycle kick and Scott McTominay header.

They scored twice in five minutes with Matias Soulé and Leonardo Balerdi to claw it back, only to go behind again to a McTominay strike from outside the box.

There was one final twist as Balerdi nodded in a Wesley cross at the back post for the 3-3 draw at the 89 th minute.

NAPLES, ITALY – OCTOBER 24: Gian Piero Gasperini AS Roma head coach during the Serie A match between SSC Napoli and AS Roma at Stadio Diego Armando Maradona on October 24, 2026 in Naples, Italy. (Photo by Francesco Pecoraro/Getty Images)

"Apart from the first half-hour, where Napoli were superior and we struggled playing out from the back, we already started to do better towards half-time and then in the second half it was wide open with many chances," Gasperini told DAZN Italia.

"We felt that we could win the game, so that third Napoli goal could've destroyed us, but instead we got back on track and felt this great conviction we could bring home three points.

"The lads were not frenetic, they didn't panic, we maintained our positions and our style of football. The goals came from quality football too, we had fresh energy with Balerdi, Molina and the others who came off the bench.

"I want to single out Soulé, who had an extraordinary performance, as did Ndicka and others. We are in a great moment of form, we have real self-belief, we play good football, and after this game we really feel as if we've dropped two points, even though considering we were 3-2 down, we'll take it."

NAPLES, ITALY – OCTOBER 24: Gian Piero Gasperini, AS Roma head coach, reacts during the Serie A match between SSC Napoli and AS Roma at Stadio Diego Armando Maradona on October 24, 2026 in Naples, Italy. (Photo by Francesco Pecoraro/Getty Images)

Roma have drawn their three biggest games in Serie A so far this season, 2-2 with Inter, 0-0 at Como when down to 10 men, and now 3-3 away to Napoli.

"They are all very different matches, but in all three we felt that we were very competitive with the best in the league," noted Gasperini.

"We came close to beating Inter, even if they recovered two goals, while with Como we were down to 10 men for practically the entire second half, but in the first half were positive. Today, considering the quality of Napoli, having come back to get the result was another positive confidence booster for us."

NAPLES, ITALY – OCTOBER 24: Matias Soule of AS Roma celebrates after scoring his team's first goal during the Serie A match between SSC Napoli and AS Roma at Stadio Diego Armando Maradona on October 24, 2026 in Naples, Italy. (Photo by Francesco Pecoraro/Getty Images)

Balerdi was a very late signing for Roma in the summer and he popped up with two goals today.

"There is no doubt that Balerdi and De Roon were leaders and captains at their clubs, their support has been extraordinary. They settled in very quickly, it was easier with De Roon because I worked with him for so many years, but Balerdi knows football, understood the defensive movements very quickly, he has remarkable energy and today scored two goals. A great reinforcement," added Gasperini.

"Napoli won the Scudetto twice in the last few years, so if you are competitive against them, it gives you the strength and confidence to fight it out with anyone."

NAPLES, ITALY – OCTOBER 24: Gian Piero Gasperini AS Roma head coach greets Massimiliano Allegri SSC Napoli head coach before the Serie A match between SSC Napoli and AS Roma at Stadio Diego Armando Maradona on October 24, 2026 in Naples, Italy. (Photo by Francesco Pecoraro/Getty Images)

Gasperini and Max Allegri are great friends, so did the Roma coach run into his Napoli counterpart after that red card on the touchline?

"No. I hope he wasn't angry with me, I wasn't the one who sent him off!" smiled Gasp.

articles.body: España, con Lucas Paulano, ha quedado segunda en Eurovisión Junior 2026 al sumar 184 puntos y quedarse a un paso de la primera que ha sido Armenia, con 202 puntos. Era uno de los favoritos y llegaba con el objetivo de conquistar el Malta Fairs & Conventions Centre de Ta’ Qali, en Malta. Naré Kerobyan, de trece años y natural de Ereván, interpretaba BOO!, una canción en armenio e inglés que invita a enfrentarse a los miedos con imaginación, valentía y diversión que resultaba ser la ganadora. Malta reunía a los 16 artistas de la 24º edición del festival. Canciones, nervios y una votación en la que los espectadores españoles también han podido apoyar a su representante. Paulano, de apenas 10 años, se hizo el año pasado con 'La Voz Kids' y ahora ha representado a España en Eurovisión Junior. Lo hace con 'Cuore Bello' (Te quiero, te quiero), una balada emotiva con la que busca acariciar el corazón de todos los presentes en el citado recinto. A la espera de ver cuándo y cómo le toca al representante español que será en la segunda parte del certamen. Ha abierto Países Bajos, y le han seguido Chipre, Portugal, Montenegro, San Marino, Francia, Polonia, Armenia. Esperando con ansias a España. Será la última. España aguarda su momento. Arranca pasadas las 21:55 las actuaciones de la segunda tanda donde España ya figura y se espera con ansias la participación de Lucas. Malta, la anfitriona, ha arrancado esta segunda fase con ‘Blue Bird’. Era uno de los momentos más especiales para el público maltés. Beppe Caruana. Y le sigue Italia con Matteo Trullu y Che Cos'è l'Amore?, una canción cuyo título significa '¿Qué es el amor?'. Cada vez queda menos para la actuación española. Ucrania con Erika Kolesnichenko, de once años, ha defendido 'NOT A LULLABY'. Macedonia con Ana Stojanoska y su canción Idnata Jas, cuyo título significa 'Mi yo del futuro'. Le ha seguido Irlanda con Caleb Kirwan y Naomi Gribben con Níos Láidre, una canción cuyo título significa 'Más fuertes'. El siguiente era Albania, representada por Eslin Kurti y su canción Kërce Me Mua, que significa 'Baila conmigo'. Y Georgia con Davit Lomidze y su 'Sun on the Rooftops'. Y ahí está España. Con Lucas Pausano. Lo hace con 'Cuore Bello' (Te quiero, te quiero), una balada emotiva y con una enorme puesta en escena para cerrar el ciclo de actuaciones. Más luminoso que nunca. Ha dejado un gran destello en su actuación. "Europa empieza a votar ya"... es el lema que han lanzado. Una de las diferencias entre Eurovisión Junior y el festival de adultos que se celebra en mayo de cada año está en su sistema de votación. En esta competición, los espectadores pueden votar por el representante de su propio país, de manera que el público español también puede apoyar a Lucas Paulano y su canción Cuore Bello, te quiero, te quiero. La votación es gratuita, se realiza por internet a través de JESC.TV y exige seleccionar tres canciones favoritas. Lou Deleuze, ganadora de Eurovisión Junior 2025, regresa al escenario para interpretar Ce Monde, la canción con la que logró el cuarto triunfo de Francia. Ya queda menos para conocer el ganador de Eurovisión Junior 2026. Se han cerrado las votaciones y ahora toca esperar al tramo final y decisivo. articles.body: For Jason Alexander, fame wasn't all it was cracked up to be. The "Seinfeld" star was a guest on Daniel Lubetzky's "Build or Break" podcast and discussed the iconic sitcom that helped shape his career. When Alexander was asked why, he explained that the transition from the fame that "Seinfeld" brought him would be hard for anyone. I never thought I would have this kind of money, that I could keep my family the way I keep them, that I would have these opportunities, that I would work with the people I've met." Alexander said that when "Seinfeld" ended, his first thought wasn't to try and replace that level of success, rather he was in awe that he was able to get there in the first place. "So, if you hit that and then that goes away, I would never go, 'Why couldn't I keep that?' I go, 'I can't believe I ever got that.' That's not what I was thinking. So for me, life gave me more than I ever dreamed of," he said. "I didn't expect that to last. I objectively could sit back. And one of the reasons that we were so adamant at the end about making money on 'Seinfeld' is because I grew up at a time when if you had a hit series on television, you never worked again. articles.body: Halloween season is upon us, and since the LSU Tigers have a bye next week, it's time for the team's mascot, Mike the Tiger, to bust out his costume. And what better way to celebrate Halloween ahead of Saturday's game against the Auburn Tigers than by dressing as Haddonfield, Illinois' favorite son (actually, maybe he's not the favorite), Michael Myers. KANSAS STATE WILDCATS' MASCOT FORCED TO COMPLETE ABSURD AMOUNT OF PUSH-UPS DURING 71-3 VICTORY What a moment. There's so much happening here. It's costume-ception. FORMER NFL QB SEAN SALISBURY WANTS OFFICIALS TO FACE POSTGAME QUESTIONS JUST LIKE PLAYERS AND COACHES Then stalking the official like he's Laurie Strode is a real choice. In a recent interview, Danielle said she told her aunt about her diagnosis weeks before the country music icon died at 80 on August 25, reportedly from an unspecified cancer.Danielle did not disclose the type of cancer she is dealing with but opened up about Dolly’s emotional reaction when she shared the news. She said she had not realised how much her aunt was dealing with her own illness at the time.Danielle Parton says Dolly was ‘devastated’ by her diagnosisSpeaking to Extra, Danielle said she was “going through a little bit of a cancer battle myself right now.” She explained that her diagnosis was at stage zero, adding that she had caught it early.Danielle recalled telling Dolly about her condition around August 6. She said her aunt took the news particularly hard, which made her realise that Dolly was likely dealing with cancer herself.“She took it really heavy, and that's how I figured out,” Danielle said, explaining that she had known Dolly was unwell but did not know the extent of what she was facing.Recalling their conversation, Danielle said Dolly was “just devastated” that her niece was going through a health battle of her own.“I remember telling her, I’m like, ‘Look, you've gotta get it together. It ain’t that deep. I just wanted you to know,’” Danielle recalled.She also described Dolly as someone who consistently put the people she loved before herself.“She worried more about everybody else before she would ever let you know anything was wrong with her,” Danielle said.Danielle Parton takes on a new role to preserve Dolly’s legacyDespite her personal health battle, Danielle is also stepping into a new role connected to her aunt’s legacy. articles.title: David Spade and Dana Carvey call out Hollywood for focusing too much on race and gender
articles.summary: David Spade and Dana Carvey urge Hollywood to stop labeling actors and directors by race and gender at award shows on their popular podcast.
articles.body: David Spade and Dana Carvey call out Hollywood's focus on race and gender. In a recent episode of their "Fly on the Wall" podcast, the two comedians questioned Hollywood's emphasis on race and gender, with Spade arguing that the industry should "stop separating us like that" by highlighting those distinctions. "On race, let me just say at any of these award shows, I saw a clip the other day saying, 'And this gentleman won, and he's the first Black director to win for this documentary,' I wish they would quit saying that because I think everyone we can't all be equal to you," Spade said. "'Oh, the first in 30 years to have a Black actor win this.' If you just say we're all actors . . .now this is my point of view, that it just makes it more even and not, we're all just the same. We're all acting." Carvey then joked that when he won his Emmy Award, they announced that he was the "198th straight white male that has won this award." ISSA RAE SAYS DEI HAS BECOME A 'BAD WORD' IN HOLLYWOOD AS EXECUTIVES OF COLOR 'TIPTOE' TO KEEP JOBS Spade also pointed out that while he was working on the hit NBC show, "Just Shoot Me," from 1997 to 2003, they would inform him anytime they would be working with a female director that week. "I [would] go, 'That's fine. Just is it a director? Yeah. Okay, we got it.' Like you don't even have to say that," Spade said. "Female director. It feels like a little, not condescending, but a little diminishing. That's a good word. It's a little 5%. Instead of going, 'We don't have a regular director,' you know what I mean? So, I was a big proponent of fighting that." Carvey agreed with his co-host, mentioning that "female director" is "a funny thing to say." articles.title: Maringá are 2026 Série C champions
articles.summary: Maringá won the 2026 Série C titleCredit: Rafael Ribeiro/CBFMaringá defeated Ferroviária 2–1 this Saturday (24) to win the 2026 Brasileirão Série C at Arena...
articles.body:
Maringá won the 2026 Série C title Credit: Rafael Ribeiro/CBF

Maringá defeated Ferroviária 2–1 this Saturday (24) to win the 2026 Brasileirão Série C at Arena Fonte Luminosa in Araraquara, São Paulo. Playing away from home, the team scored through Lucas Bonifácio and Ronald Camarão to become champions of the competition's 36th edition.

Despite the presence of 11,500 home fans, the Paraná side were not intimidated by the pressure, especially early in the match. They built their lead within ten minutes and secured the victory.

The São Paulo side went on the attack, needing a win after a 1–1 draw in the first leg. They created chances to break through Dogão's defense but were thwarted by a strong performance from Maringá goalkeeper Guilherme Neto. Denílson pulled one back late in the second half, but they could not find an equalizer to take the final to penalties.

The 2026 Série C championship was Maringá's first national title in their 16-year history.

Maringá fans celebrated at Arena Fonte Luminosa Credit: Rafael Ribeiro/CBF

Maringá opened the scoring just three minutes in. The goal came after Caíque Calito broke away at pace and had his shot deflected for a corner. Negueba took the corner, Ronald headed it on, and Lucas Bonifácio fired into the net.

Caíque Calito again threatened the opposition defense and passed to Adeílson, who was unmarked in the box and facing goal but shot over the bar. It was a huge chance wasted by the Paraná side.

That miss could have proved even more painful for Maringá when Ferroviária were awarded a penalty for a foul on Ricardinho. The decision, however, was overturned after a VAR review.

After nearly seeing the hosts equalize, Dogão extended their lead. Ronald Camarão, who scored in the first leg, made the difference once again. He met Jhow's cross in the six-yard box and simply had to tap it into the net.

Lucas Bonifácio opened the scoring for Maringá in the second leg of the Série C final Credit: Rafael Ribeiro/CBF

Trailing 2–0, Ferroviária pushed forward and left gaps at the back. In the 21st minute, Zé Vitor surged forward from midfield but was dispossessed by Caíque Calito. Calito launched a counterattack and played the ball into the box. Adeílson cleverly dummied it, allowing the ball to reach Lucas Bonifácio, who hit the post.

Unhappy with his team's performance, Ferroviária coach Rogério Corrêa made two changes before the half-hour mark. Ricardinho and Carlão came off for Arthur Schilling and Guilherme Ferreira, respectively.

The changes paid off. In the 32nd minute, Maringá's Ronald nearly scored an own goal while trying to clear a cross. Two minutes later, Vitor Barreto was in the six-yard box, ready to pull one back, when Thiago Rosa stepped in to clear. In the 40th minute, Vitor Barreto exchanged passes with Juninho before shooting straight at goalkeeper Guilherme Neto.

Maringá and Ferroviária contested the 2026 Série C title Credit: Rafael Ribeiro/CBF

In stoppage time, Locomotiva continued to search for a goal. Albano's header forced a good save from Guilherme Neto, who also kept out a header from Guilherme Ferreira. Despite their repeated chances, the hosts went into halftime trailing 2–0, with chants of "Let's turn it around, AFE!" ringing out.

Coach Ivan Campanari's halftime talk with the Maringá players brought a change in approach after the team had come under pressure late in the first half. Two minutes after the restart, Adeílson Maranhão fired over from inside the six-yard box, nearly scoring Ferroviária's third goal. In the 12th minute, Edison Negueba found space to shoot from outside the box and forced a fine save from Dênis Junior.

After twenty minutes of alternating possession with no major scoring chances, Ferroviária brought the final back to life. Denilson received a pass from Fau and pulled one back for the hosts with a fine strike. The Locomotiva fans responded with chants of "I believe."

In stoppage time, Ferroviária threatened Maringá's defense with free kicks near the box, taken by Lucas Rodrigues and Albano, and dangerous crosses. Adeílson and Gabriel Souza showed that the Paraná side would not surrender the title. Full time: Ferroviária 1–2 Maringá.

Congratulations, Maringá, 2026 Série C champions!

articles.title: Mercedes' Antonelli claim pole position for F1 US Grand Prix
articles.summary: Formula One championship leader Kimi Antonelli claimed pole position on Saturday for the United States Grand Prix. The Mercedes driver clocked the fastest ti...
articles.body:
Formula One championship leader Kimi Antonelli claimed pole position on Saturday for the United States Grand Prix.

The Mercedes driver clocked the fastest time of 1 minute 34.035 seconds in his first flying lap of the final block of qualifying and nobody was able to beat that time in the second run.

Max Verstappen 0.179 seconds behind in second, followed by Red Bull team-mate Isack Hadjar, who was 0.215 seconds off the pace.

Ferrari disappointed after claiming top spot in all practice sessions and were fourth and fifth with Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton respectively.

George Russell in the other Mercedes was sixth, followed by the McLaren duo of Oscar Piastri and defending champion Lando Norris.

Antonelli could claim the drivers' title this weekend and become F1's youngest ever champion at 20 years old. However, his chances of doing so on Sunday are unlikely, especially after the resurgent Verstappen won the last two races in Malaysia and Singapore.

He would need to win the race and for Russell to be not better than ninth and Hamilton not better than fifth.

But it's a matter of time until Antonelli can celebrate his maiden F1 crown as he holds a 102-point lead over Russell with six races to go.

Four-time world champion Sebastian Vettel, now retired, is currently the youngest F1 champion. He won his first title at 23 years, 134 days in 2010.

articles.title: Antonelli takes US pole on weekend he can win title
articles.summary: Kimi Antonelli secures pole position for the United States Grand Prix on the weekend on which he can potentially clinch his first world title.
articles.body:
Kimi Antonelli took pole position for the United States Grand Prix on the weekend on which he can potentially clinch his first world title.

The Mercedes driver beat Red Bull's Max Verstappen by 0.179 seconds, with the Dutchman's team-mate Isack Hadjar third ahead of Ferrari's Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton.

Antonelli whooped with delight as he took his first pole position since the Belgian Grand Prix in July and said: "It feels good to be back."

The 20-year-old Italian will become world champion on Sunday if he wins the race with Hamilton lower than fourth and Russell lower than eighth.

Hamilton is already below that position having qualified fifth, while Russell will start sixth ahead of the McLarens of Oscar Piastri and Lando Norris.

Antonelli's pole came as something of a surprise after the Ferraris had topped all three practice sessions and Verstappen had looked strong through the second part of qualifying.

"I wasn't expecting that," said Antonelli's engineer Peter Bonnington, emphasising that his charge's first lap in final qualifying was good enough for pole.

Verstappen had been fourth quickest in Q2 despite being on used tyres but he found his car lacked the requisite grip in the final session.

Antonelli said: "We got pole so we will try to win tomorrow but Max has been very quick and Isack did an incredible job so it is not going to be easy.

"We try to get a good start and hopefully lead into Turn One and try to set the pace, even though it's going to be very tight."

Verstappen said: "Q3 was not good, Q1, Q2 were nice but for whatever reason in run one and two just didn't have a nice balance. No mistakes, just not enough grip. But if it's still a P2, I take it."

Hadjar was just 0.036secs behind the four-time champion while the Ferraris faded when it mattered, as they have so many times this season.

Leclerc, fastest in second and third practice, was 0.232secs off the pace and pipped Hamilton by just 0.044secs.

Russell was 0.441secs off his team-mate while the fastest McLaren was 0.768secs from pole despite an upgrade for this weekend as Norris' best lap time was deleted for breaching track limits.

The Racing Bulls of Arvid Lindblad and Liam Lawson took ninth and 10th places but the Briton will be demoted five places because of a penalty for using too many engine parts.
